packages.title: A task that sounds like a command still becomes a task
brief: Context: every dictation, and every typed capture with Pro, now asks the assistant for commands (App/lib/services/capture_processor.dart:229-232). Everyday task titles start with command verbs: «Cambiar la cita del dentista», «Cambia el aceite del coche el sábado», «Busca piso en Valencia», «Buscar a los niños a las 5», «Borrar las fotos del móvil». When one comes back as a change, a deletion or a search that finds nothing, the result offers only «Cerrar» (and «Volver a decirlo» while dictations are left): the thought isn't captured, and a free account has spent a dictation. Shared text, which is someone else's words full of imperatives, is sent the same way with Pro. This package makes such a result end in a task, and stops asking for commands on shares.

UX-901 (S3), part 1, the way out. In `CaptureResult` (voice_task_screen.dart:2130-3449) a result is read-only when `readOnly` (:3229-3230). When it is read-only and every card shown is either a change or a deletion that found nothing (`CommandView.notFound`, capture_command_cards.dart:57-60; this includes a target whose only matches are in projects the person can't edit) or a search with no results (`view.found.isEmpty`), show the existing «Guardar tal cual» (`captureSaveAsWritten`: “Save as written” / «Guardar tal cual» / «Desa-ho tal com està») as the filled button, full width, above «Cerrar» (`_exits(close: true)`, :3415). «Volver a decirlo» stays where it shows today. A search that found tasks, and a change that found its task (for example «Ya está así.»), keep today's footer with no filled button.

UX-901 part 1, what the tap does: exactly what «Guardar tal cual» does after a slow answer (U7, `_saveAsWritten`, :1319-1351). The phone's parser builds the task from the result's words: use the result's `transcript`, falling back to the capture's `text`, because a dictation transcribed online may have no `text`. None of the commands is applied, and the saved capture holds none. The task saves at once (`saveAtOnce`) and lands on Calendar lit, with «Añadida al …» and Deshacer, like any save. Pass this to `CaptureResult` as a callback from the sheet's state, beside `onSayAgain` (:2131-2145); don't write a second parser path, and make sure `CaptureProcessor.asWritten` (capture_processor.dart:56-73) can't fail on an empty `text` here. It sends nothing to the assistant, so a free account spends no second dictation; it is allowed without Pro because it is a dictation's fallback (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-18 later).

UX-901 part 2, completed matches say so. On change and deletion cards (UpdateCommandCard :682-921, DeleteCommandCard :923-992), when the task, or the repetition shown, is completed, add the existing «Completada» (`commandCompleted`: “Completed” / «Completada» / «Completada») as a quiet `_Note` right under the card's first line. On pick-list rows (`_Choice`, :623-645) append it to the day line with « · », as found rows do (:543). Use the same completed rule as `_FoundRow` (:532-533).

UX-904 (S2), shares are tasks. `CaptureStore.acceptEntry` (capture_store.dart:111-146) stores shared text with `source: 'shared'` instead of 'typed'. In `CaptureProcessor._process` (capture_processor.dart:218-233), a shared capture sends `'source': 'typed'` (the server knows only speech and typed) and no `commands`; dictations and words the person typed keep `'commands': true` (decision 7 of the voice-commands plan: typed commands with Pro). Every test of `source == 'speech'` or `!= 'speech'` in voice_task_screen.dart (:535, :667, :1230, :1441, :1473, :1756, :1772, :3239) already treats 'shared' as typed; keep it so. A shared capture keeps 'shared' when its words are edited (:738).

Don't touch: the cards' layout and wording beyond the «Completada» line (P128 and later packages change them); the label «Guardar tal cual» (renaming it waits on D3, UX-919); «Volver a decirlo»; free-dictation counting; Backend/.
acceptance: ES, 1× on 390×844: a dictation answered with one `update` whose target matches no task (transcript «Cambia el aceite del coche el sábado») shows «No encuentro ninguna tarea con «…»» with the command's words, a filled «Guardar tal cual», and «Cerrar» under it.

ES: tapping that «Guardar tal cual» sends no second request to ai/drafts/, saves a task titled «Cambia el aceite del coche» dated next Saturday, closes the sheet, and Calendar shows that Saturday with the row lit and «Añadida al {weekdayDate}» with Deshacer.

ES: a result whose `update` found its task but has nothing to change («Ya está así.») shows no «Guardar tal cual».

Unit: a capture accepted through `acceptEntry` is stored with source 'shared'; processing it sends source 'typed' and no `commands` key; a typed capture with Pro sends `commands: true`; a spoken one sends `commands: true`.

brief: Context: the plan's own example, «Crea un proyecto de matemáticas y añade terminar la presentación para el 12», returns a task with only a deadline. packages.title: Sign-in errors name the problem: a wrong password, and how long to wait
brief: Context, UX-402 (reopened): the real server answers a wrong password, or an address with no account, with 401 and the detail «Email or password is incorrect.» (Backend/core/auth_views.py:173). `requestProblem` (request_locale.dart:80-82) recognises only simplejwt's wording, so the 401 falls to `session` (:95) and sign-in says «Vuelve a iniciar sesión para continuar. Tus tareas locales se conservan.», without «Crear una cuenta con este correo» (UX-402) or «¿Has olvidado tu contraseña?» (UX-488). The app's tests pass only because they fake simplejwt's text (auth_gate_test.dart:277, :600, :727). Context, UX-1208: every 429 on the auth screens says «Demasiadas solicitudes. Espera un poco antes de volver a intentarlo.» (`rateLimit`), though the server sends the wait (Retry-After 900 for sign-in's 15-minute lock, auth_views.py:166-167; read into `ApiException.retryAfter`, api_client.dart:536-546).

UX-402 (S3): classify by status and endpoint, not by English text. In `ApiClient.signIn` (api_client.dart:210-243), a 401 from `auth/login/` (not register) means wrong credentials, whatever its wording: rethrow it as an `ApiException` that carries a marker of the app's own, keeping status, message and retryAfter, and make `requestProblem` (request_locale.dart:78-97) read that marker first, before its text rules and its generic 401 → `session` rule (:95). Use a field, or a body key, that no other rule reads: a body `email` key already means `email` (:79), and a 400 with a body `code` key means `recoveryCode` (:90). Keep the simplejwt matches for older servers. The copy stays (`requestError` credentials: «No encontramos esa cuenta o la contraseña no es correcta.»), and `unknownAccount` (login_screen.dart:320-325) then offers «Crear una cuenta con este correo», or after «Iniciar sesión con este correo» the recovery button (UX-488).

UX-1208 (S1), the wait: in whole minutes rounded up, at least 1, from `retryAfter` or else DRF's English ending, as the delete page's `_waitMinutesFor` does (delete_account_screen.dart:178-191). Move that helper beside `requestProblem` in request_locale.dart, and rename the key `deleteAccountThrottledWait` to a shared `tooManyTriesWait`, its text unchanged: “{minutes, plural, =1{Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.} other{Too many tries. Wait {minutes} minutes and try again.}}” / «{minutes, plural, =1{Demasiados intentos. Espera un minuto y vuelve a intentarlo.} other{Demasiados intentos. Espera {minutes} minutos y vuelve a intentarlo.}}» / «{minutes, plural, =1{Massa intents. Espera un minut i torna-ho a provar.} other{Massa intents. Espera {minutes} minuts i torna-ho a provar.}}». The delete page uses the moved helper and the renamed key, unchanged for the person.

UX-1208, where: in `requestProblemText` called with `onSignIn: true` (the auth screens: verify_email_screen.dart:119 and login_screen.dart's `problem`), a `rateLimit` answer whose wait is known shows `tooManyTriesWait(minutes)`; without a known wait `rateLimit` stays. That covers the confirm screen, «Crea tu cuenta» and sign-in. Other screens keep today's line.

Tests: those that fake simplejwt's wording keep passing; ux-tester adds the server's real answer. Update the tests that read `deleteAccountThrottledWait` (App/test/delete_account_test.dart) to the new key.
Don't touch: the server; sign-in's password rules; other 401s (a session that ended elsewhere still reads `session`).
acceptance: ES, sign-in mode: a login answered 401 with the detail «Email or password is incorrect.» shows «No encontramos esa cuenta o la contraseña no es correcta.» and the button «Crear una cuenta con este correo», with the email kept; no «Vuelve a iniciar sesión…» line shows.

Espera un minuto y vuelve a intentarlo.»; sign-in answered 429 with Retry-After 900 shows «Demasiados intentos. packages.title: Confirm your email: the answer in view, the keyboard steady, an honest «expired»
brief: Context, App/lib/screens/verify_email_screen.dart: on the 6th digit the field turns read-only (:312), which closes Android's keyboard; on a refusal it comes back and covers the message, and nothing scrolls the answer into view (sign-in does, `_reveal`, login_screen.dart:128-158). The field is autofocused (:308), so on arrival the keyboard also hides «Reenviar código» and «Usar otro correo», the way out for someone who still has to fetch the code. The server answers `code_expired` both for a spent code and for an address already confirmed (Backend/core/auth_views.py:118-122), for example after the right code's answer was lost, and resend then sends nothing. Confirmar and the keyboard's ✓ resend refused digits, spending tries (5 lock the code). «Pide uno nuevo» names an action the screen calls «Reenviar código», and on `code_expired` the countdown is cancelled (:196-199), inviting a resend the server drops within the minute.

Any other answer: its own line under the field (`requestProblemText(l, error, onSignIn: true)`, which names a wait since P132). The screen stays in its confirming state meanwhile.

UX-1204 (S2), part 1, don't resend refused digits: remember the last refused code; Confirmar, ✓ or six digits typed again that equal it send nothing and show that refusal's line again. Changing a digit clears the line, as today.

UX-1204 part 2, `verifyEmailCodeInvalid` says what to do: “That code isn’t right. Check the newest email we sent.” / «Ese código no es correcto. Mira el último correo que te hemos enviado.» / «Aquest codi no és correcte. Mira l’últim correu que t’hem enviat.».

UX-1204 part 3, expired or locked, after UX-1203's check; never cancel the countdown on `code_expired` (remove :196-199). At least 60 s since `_sentAt`: that sign-in sent a new code, so empty and focus the field, set `_sentAt` to now and restart the countdown, as after Reenviar, and show new `verifyEmailCodeSpentNew` “That code no longer works. We’ve sent you a new one.” / «Ese código ya no sirve. Te hemos enviado uno nuevo.» / «Aquest codi ja no serveix. T’hem enviat un codi nou.». Within the 60 s: keep the countdown running, and show new `verifyEmailCodeSpentWait` “That code no longer works. Tap “Resend code” when the countdown ends.” / «Ese código ya no sirve. Toca «Reenviar código» cuando acabe la cuenta atrás.» / «Aquest codi ja no serveix. Toca «Torna a enviar el codi» quan acabi el compte enrere.» (settled by the organizer: review D's «Pide otro…» would repeat the two-names problem it reports, so the line names the button, `verifyEmailResend`; the Catalan is the organizer's). Remove `verifyEmailCodeExpired` from the three catalogs.

Whether «Te hemos enviado…» can be untrue past the server's hourly cap waits on D9 (UX-1206): don't build anything for it. packages.title: Confirm your email survives the trip to the inbox
brief: Context: the password lives only in memory (verify_email_screen.dart:30-38), the screen is a plain pushed route (login_screen.dart:184-207), and a cold start without a session opens a blank sign-in (main.dart:427-431). If Android kills TaskFlow while the person reads the email (a low-memory phone, or «Cerrar todo» in recent apps), they come back to «Inicia sesión», must retype the 12-character password they invented a minute ago, and signing in or creating the account again emails a new code that replaces the one they just read.

UX-1202 (S3): remember the pending address, never the password. Keep it from the moment «Confirma tu correo» opens until the address is confirmed, «Usar otro correo» is tapped, or 30 minutes pass (the code's life). Store only the address and when it was saved, in the kind of storage a pending invitation uses (App/lib/services/invitation_links.dart: FlutterSecureStorage, injectable for tests), behind a provider tests can replace. The file name above is a suggestion.

On a cold start with no session and a pending address younger than 30 minutes, open «Confirma tu correo» for it straight away, over sign-in, without a password: its own password field already exists for this case (`widget.password == null`, verify_email_screen.dart:354-383; tested at App/test/email_verification_test.dart:727). Send nothing on the way (no sign-in, no resend), so the code in the inbox still works. Not when sign-in is the session-expiry screen (`signInAgain`). An older entry is dropped.

In that case (the screen asks for the password itself), a `signup_replaced` answer most likely means a mistyped password, since verify checks the password first (Backend/docs/EMAIL_VERIFICATION.md:39): stay on the screen and show new `verifyEmailWrongPassword` under the password field: “That isn’t this account’s password.” / «Esa contraseña no es la de esta cuenta.» / «Aquesta contrasenya no és la d’aquest compte.». The same line shows there when P133's sign-in check answers wrong credentials. After sign-up or sign-in (password passed in), `signup_replaced` keeps today's return to «Crea tu cuenta».
Back keeps the pending address (the person may come back for it); «Usar otro correo» and a confirmed address clear it.
Don't touch: the server; what the screen asks when it opens from sign-up or sign-in. The password is never written anywhere.
acceptance: ES: open the confirm screen after a sign-up, then rebuild the app as a cold start with the same storage and no session: «Confirma tu correo» opens for that address with the password field, and no request was sent.
ES: the same after the clock moves 31 minutes, after «Usar otro correo», or after the address was confirmed: the cold start opens plain sign-in.

UX-914 part 2: when no editable task matches but tasks in view-only projects would (the same match without the edit filter), the card's line is new `commandViewOnly`, with the first such task's title: “{title}” is in a project you can only view. / ««{title}» es de un proyecto que solo puedes ver.» / ««{title}» és d’un projecte que només pots veure.». English wraps the title in “…”, as the other lines do. Like «No encuentro…» it has no ✕ and nothing to apply (P127's «Guardar tal cual» counts it as found nothing).

UX-914 part 3: under «Hay varias personas que se llaman {name}.», one chip per person in the task's project who can edit and whose name starts with the name said (ignoring case and accents, `foldForSearch`), one tap each. The tap resolves the change's assignee to that person, so the before → after line shows them and the change is ready. Keep the choice with the command (it is stored with the capture), as `taskId` is.
Don't touch: the order of matches, the deletion card's look, «Elegir otra», the plan's other fields, Backend/.
acceptance: ES: an `update` whose words match 8 tasks shows 5 rows and «Ver 3 más»; tapping it shows all 8; tapping the 7th makes it the chosen task, and the card shows its before → after.
ES: an `update` whose only matching task «Informe» is in a project the account can only view shows ««Informe» es de un proyecto que solo puedes ver.» and no «No encuentro…».

packages.title: Free accounts' way into the form: «Escribir», shares straight in, why there's no mic, nothing lost
brief: Context: for an account without Pro (`typesInFormProvider`), typed words become a task only through the form (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-18 later). Today: (a) the sheet's keyboard became «✏ Rellenar a mano», naming a form nobody has seen (voice_task_screen.dart:2054-2062), and «Listo» reads it on typed words (:1765-1772, :1820); (b) a free account's shared text opens the sheet with the words and «Rellenar a mano» as its only way on (main.dart:188-203): one screen too many; (c) at 0 left the home-screen widget («Toca para dictar una tarea») and the «Dictar una tarea» shortcut open the form, and after the month's notice nothing says why there's no mic (`askedToSpeak` is dropped, :76-87); (d) «Rellenar a mano» discards the capture before the form opens (:1488-1490), and the form keeps everything only in memory (edit_task_screen.dart:80-117, task_editor.dart:144-176), so if Android closes the app during the photo picker (task_editor.dart:479-535) or a call, the words are gone; (e) entries from outside the app open without `showCalendar` (main.dart:195-202), so a task saved while the app was on Tareas, Notas or Ajustes lands on Calendar out of sight (main_shell.dart:44-50).

UX-911 (S2), part 1: the free account's keyboard button reads the existing `captureTypeInstead`: “Type instead” / «Escribir» / «Escriu», with `Icons.keyboard_outlined`, still a labelled TextButton.icon that opens the form (`_fillByHand`). On typed words the filled button reads `done` («Listo») and still opens the form (`_done`, :1455-1463). Delete `captureFillByHand` from the three catalogs, and update the comments that name it (:59-62, :1465-1478, :2034-2037).

UX-911 part 2: for an account without Pro, shared text (main.dart:188-203) and a typed or shared capture with no result, reopened from «Sin guardar» (captures_screen.dart:83, through `showCaptureSheet`), open straight in the form (`openTaskForm` with that capture) instead of the sheet. The words become the title and notes as `NewTaskScreen._start` already splits them (`leadingTitle`, edit_task_screen.dart:90-110). Route it in `showCaptureSheet` (:76-87), so every way in follows one rule. With Pro nothing changes.

UX-1005 (S2, review B), the form keeps the words until it saves, in the capture store (`captureStoreProvider`), by the sheet's rule since UX-102: «Escribir» hands its capture to the form instead of discarding it (:1479-1511); the new-task form writes its title and notes into that capture as they change (the capture's text is the title, then a line break and the notes when there are any, so `leadingTitle` reads them back), or into a new typed capture created at the first character typed, never before; it discards the capture when the task is saved (the button, or Back with a title, D12) and when it closes with an empty title. If Android closes the app, the words wait under «Sin guardar», and opening them opens the form again (part 2). Only the title and notes are kept, not the day, steps or files. No new copy. Don't read dates out of the words (that waits on D2, UX-918).

UX-910 (S2): `showCaptureSheet`'s form branch passes `askedToSpeak` to `openTaskForm`, and `NewTaskArguments` carries it. When the form opened from the widget or the voice shortcut without a mic, it shows above the title the line the sheet showed for these entries (:1855-1879): `freeVoiceUsedUpText` («Sin dictados gratis hasta el {date}.» / “No free dictations until {date}.” / «Fins al dia {date} no tens dictats gratuïts.»), or `captureSpeakingIsPro` when the server sent no count, with key `free-voice-used-up` on the line, and «Ver Pro» (`voiceProAction`, which opens /subscription). Every time, also after the month's notice. «Nueva tarea» and the text shortcut open the form without it. No new strings. The shortcut's own wording is an open owner question; don't touch it.

UX-1011 (S2, from review B's U5 notes): the entries' `showCaptureSheet` call in main.dart (:195-202) passes `showCalendar: true`, as the pending list (captures_screen.dart:83) and the timeline already do, so a task saved from the widget, a shortcut or a share lands on Calendar in view whichever tab was showing. `showCaptureSheet` already hands `showCalendar` to the form.
Don't touch: Pro's sheet, typing and shares; free-dictation counting; the used-up notice (P140 changes its words); the form's layout (P139, P140); Backend/.
acceptance: ES and CA at 2× on 320×640, free account with dictations left, in the mic sheet: the keyboard button reads «Escribir» (CA «Escriu») with the keyboard icon, whole and inside the screen; tapping it opens «Nueva tarea» with the words heard as the title.
Catalogs: `captureFillByHand` exists in none.
ES, free account: shared «Pedir cita en el dentista» opens «Nueva tarea» with that title and no capture sheet; the capture store holds the share's capture until «Añadir tarea», and none after it.
ES, free account: a typed capture «Comprar pan» under «Sin guardar», tapped, opens the form titled «Comprar pan».
ES, Pro: shared text still opens the capture sheet with the words.

ES, free account at 0 left, the month's notice already seen: a `voice` entry (the widget) opens the form with the `free-voice-used-up` line «Sin dictados gratis hasta el …» and «Ver Pro» above the title; «Nueva tarea» opens it without that line.

ES: «Escribir» in the mic sheet, then typing in the form: exactly one capture exists (the sheet's) until the save.
ES: with the app on the Tareas tab, a widget entry (Pro) saved from the sheet switches to the Calendario tab with the day selected and the row lit; the same for the form at 0 left.
deviceChecks: Phone, Developer options › «No mantener actividades» on: Nueva tarea, type a title, then Más detalles › Añadir adjunto › Elegir una foto; back in TaskFlow, the words are under «Sin guardar» and open in the form.

packages.title: The new-task form at large text: keyboard down for choices, a title that wraps, one way to add a time
brief: Context: Nueva tarea opens on the title with the keyboard up (task_editor.dart:606). At 2× on 320×640 with the keyboard, only the title and the top half of Hoy and Mañana show (renders new-task-form-2x-es and -2x-ca); tapping a chip leaves the keyboard up, and when the date sheet or the time picker closes, Flutter gives the focus back to the title, so the keyboard rises over the time just set. The title is one line, so about 12 letters show at 2× (:601-631). «Añadir hora» opens Android's clock dial (:224-242), where 17 sits on an inner ring 28 dp inside 5; «Elegir día» opens the full «Fecha y hora» sheet (schedule_editor.dart:201-204), with a second «Añadir hora», and needs «Listo» after a date is tapped (:284-301, :412-416).

UX-1002 (S2): when Hoy, Mañana, Elegir día, «Añadir hora» or the time chip is tapped (`_dayAndTime`, :943-1010), first take the focus off the title (`FocusScope.of(context).unfocus()`, as `_save` :333 and Más detalles :700 do). The keyboard goes down and the rest of the form shows; no sheet or picker brings it back; tapping the title does.

UX-1003 (S2): the title field (:601-631) sets `minLines: 1, maxLines: 3, keyboardType: TextInputType.text` and keeps its `textInputAction` (done for tasks), so it wraps to three lines and the keyboard's action key still closes the keyboard instead of adding a line. A time already chosen in the form is kept on the new day, as `_setDay` does. The capture result's sheet and the edit form's keep the full sheet.

UX-1004, the time: the form's «Añadir hora» and its time chip open `showTimePicker(..., initialEntryMode: TimePickerEntryMode.input)`, so the hour and minutes go in on the number keys, like the rest of the app.
No copy change. Don't touch: the form's order, its button, D12's Back, the chips' labels.
acceptance: ES, Manrope, 2× on 320×640 with the keyboard: type a title and tap Mañana; nothing has the primary focus, and «Añadir hora» and «Más detalles» are hit-testable without scrolling.
ES: then tap «Añadir hora» and confirm 17:00; the title still isn't focused, and the «17:00» chip is hit-testable.

«Añadir hora» opens the time picker in TimePickerEntryMode.input.
The capture result's date sheet still has «Añadir hora» and «Listo».
deviceChecks: Phone, the largest font on a 360 dp phone: title › Mañana › Añadir hora › 17:00; the keyboard stays down and «17:00» stays in view.

decisions.question: Should «Reenviar código» admit when no code was sent?
decisions.recommendation: Yes. When this address's own limit blocks a code (5 codes an hour, 8 emails a day), the server answers 429 with Retry-After, and the app says «Has pedido muchos códigos. Espera {n} minutos para pedir otro.» and keeps Reenviar off. It tells someone pressing resend that an unconfirmed sign-up exists for that address, which is worth little: they typed it. Server first (main session), then the app half in a later run.

decisions.question: Does asking for commands on every dictation slow down plain capture?
decisions.recommendation: Measure before deciding (main session, staging, same phone and network): 10 or more one-task dictations with the commands flag and 10 or more without it, reading extraction_ms p50 and p95 in Diagnóstico de captura. If the flag adds 300 ms or more at p50, the cause is the longer prompt on the server: decide it with UX-616 (a shorter commands section, a faster model, or the paid fallback). Speed is the selling point, so it's worth the half hour.
decisions.status: answered 2026-10-18 (night), DECISIONS.md, for the owner while he is away
decisions.answer: Measured locally on 2026-10-18 with the real free model, 12 one-task Spanish dictations each way: median 3.5 s with the commands flag and 4.3 s without (p95 3.8 s and 4.6 s), no false commands. The flag stays. No work; UX-912 closed.
